name: MedinCell S.A.
summary: MedinCell S.A. engages in the research and development of biodegradable polymer-based processes for the controlled and prolonged delivery of active pharmaceutical ingredients into the human body and animals in France. The company offers UZEDY, a subcutaneous risperidone for the treatment of schizophrenia. It also develops mdc-TJK, a subcutaneous injection, which is in NDA stage for the treatment of schizophrenia; and mdc-CWM, a sustained-release formulation of celecoxib, which is in Phase III clinical trial for the treatment and reduction of post-operative pain and inflammation.
